chunks: About a man who is performing tawaf around the House, then the time of al-'Asr enters: should he perform sa'y before he prays, or should he pray before he performs sa'y? He said: "There is no harm in praying and then performing sa'y."

key_terms.رِفَاعَةُ: Rifa'ah, the narrator who posed the question
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.يَسْعَى: to perform sa'y between al-Safa and al-Marwah

ai.seo_question: If the time of al-'Asr begins during tawaf, should one pray before performing sa'y?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the order of acts during hajj or 'umrah when the time for salat begins during tawaf-related rites. It states that there is no harm in performing the prayer first and then completing the sa'y, showing flexibility in prioritizing the obligatory prayer time.
